# system.openPage

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Open a page.

```lua
system.openPage(page)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ``page`` | table | yes | with elements: |

Fields of ``page``:

- `system` (integer or nil): system page index or nil for the menu page
- `model` (integer or nil): model page index or nil for the menu page
- `home` (integer, optional): home page index
- `logicSwitch` (integer, optional): logic switch page index
- `timer` (integer, optional): timer page index
- `sensor` (integer, optional): sensor page index


## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
system.openPage({system=nil}) -- System menu page
system.openPage({system=0}) -- System / File manager
system.openPage({model=nil}) -- Model menu page
system.openPage({model=0}) -- Model / Model select
system.openPage({home=0}) -- Home page 1
system.openPage({timer=0}) -- Timer 1 configuration
system.openPage({logicSwitch=0}) -- Logic switch 1 configuration
system.openPage({sensor=0}) -- Sensor 1 configuration
```

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 2 times across 2 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    local function launchSystemTool(widget)
      if not canOpenSystemTool() then return end
      setToolbarVisible(widget, false)
      requestPaint(widget)
      invalidateWidget(widget)
      system.openPage({system = systemToolHandle})
    end
    ```
